name: Fleet Atlas
notes: Hangar cards and local-space hulls (all 20 player ships plus NPC/traffic/security) pick up class kits: framed canopies with depth, recessed ceramic bells, radiators, antennae, cargo-bay doors, docking clamps, and combat hardpoints.
A scout, hauler, and gunship no longer share one extruded wedge. Flight, docking, hitboxes, and menus are unchanged. Stars stay the 2.15.0 spectral pass.
Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.15.2 so Pages picks up the craft paint.
